name: Ege Endustri ve Ticaret A.S.
summary: Ege Endüstri ve Ticaret A.S. develops, manufactures, and sells axle and axle parts for the automotive industry in Turkey and internationally. It offers differential sleeves, complete rear axles, additional axles, trailer axles, directional additional axles, front axles, bellows carriers, independent suspension front axle system, and other axles components. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in Izmir, Turkey. Ege Endüstri ve Ticaret A.S. is a subsidiary of Bayraktar Holding A.S.
